question: Which part of the OCR plausibility gate of PR #55 (issue #39) survives the UZP counting rules (issue #59)?
decision: Trim: cut a scanner-noise tail and strip trailing stray symbols, so a value that is still close keeps its match. Null: only a value that is scanner noise throughout and is unlikely to match anyway (FP -> FN is neutral, FP -> TN when the reference is absent is a gain). Titles are trim-only. A titled law-firm name is never nulled for its ending: capitals after a full name leave it a match.

variants.pr_as_opened: origin/main d9a3b25 with the ocr_plausibility.py and ocr_extract.py call site of fix/ocr-plausibility fe66789: null on any stray symbol, on a letter ratio below 0.6, or on a lawyer name ending in capitals noise; cut after the legal form
variants.this_branch: the product commit d857521 merged with origin/main d9a3b25: trim a noise tail after a corporate legal form and trailing stray symbols; null a value that is scanner noise throughout (stray symbols and no letters; mixed-case text with three or more stray-symbol tokens where at least half of all tokens are noise); titles are trim-only; values printed verbatim on native pages are skipped

metrics.strict: evals.metrics.compare_strict (null = null is a hit, a wrong value is FP and FN, exact strings after whitespace and case normalisation)
metrics.uzp: evals.metrics.compare (issue #59): TN outside F1, a wrong value is one FP, an extra value where the reference is absent is FP, the five long-string paths match at normalised Levenshtein similarity >= 0.80. UZP has not confirmed its similarity function.

template_scan.note: input/case1/przyklad odwolanie.pdf; the organizer's expected file is empty, so the reference was read from the page: the appellant name is under a black box and was taken from the body text (UNCONFIRMED), the law firm name is redacted and not scored. Three long-string fields, UZP counting.

injected_damage.note: stress test of the rules on the organizer's 70 appeal references, not a rate of real OCR damage; each long-string value is damaged, then scored with evals.metrics.matches

recipes.stray_symbol_inside_value: insert ' | ' after the first half of the words (after the first word for a one-word value)
recipes.short_capitals_appended: append ' EBX' (capitals without a rule, the shape a lawyer-title rule once nulled)
recipes.template_style_tail_appended: append ' M KENZI NJ EMME Warszawa W LDLT BE LILII ZM'
recipes.lookalike_letters: replace one character in twenty by a look-alike (o 0, l 1, i l, e c, a o, n u, m rn, s 5), random.Random(7)
